levels.surface: ابن عثمان بن عبد الله بن موهب

notes: «وقال بهز حدثنا شعبة ... بهذا» is a second isnad after the saying with the same saying, so it is a second group; «بهذا» names the same saying and is not written as a link
the remark «محمد غير محفوظ إنما هو عمرو» names a different transmitter for the second route: written as a variant group
the man who asks the Prophet is in the scene, not a link; the editor glosses are left out
